import sys
input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
t = int(input[0])
results = []
for i in range(1, t + 1):
    s = input[i]
    ca = s.count('A')
    cb = s.count('B')
    cc = s.count('C')
    if (ca == cb == cc) or (ca - cb == 0 and cb - cc == 0):
        results.append('YES')
    else:
        results.append('NO')
print('\n'.join(results))
